name: UrbanCore Nashik AOI boundary polygons (census-2011 village units)

properties.match_note: Gangapur village polygon. "Gangapur Road" is a road/neighbourhood; the census village is only the village core, so the real Gangapur Road area may extend beyond it. A 0.07 km2 Gangapur fragment is ignored.
properties.source: Census of India 2011 village boundaries via DataMeet (indian_village_boundaries), ODbL

properties.match_note: Adgaon village polygon (now inside NMC limits).

properties.match_note: Dahbhadgaon village polygon contains 99% of the AOI box. Satpur MIDC is not a census unit; this is the village it mostly sits in, not the MIDC estate boundary.

properties.match_note: Wadivarhe village polygon contains the whole AOI box. Gonde MIDC is not a census unit; nearby Gondedumala (7.9 km2) is the other candidate.

properties.match_note: Mhasarul village polygon contains the whole AOI box. "Dindori Road" is a road, not a village: polygon is the containing unit, not the road corridor.

properties.match_note: Ozar census town polygon (Niphad). Other villages named Ozar in Kalwan sub-district are NOT this one.
